info.name: SSG Voting System API
info.description: Complete Laravel API collection for the College SSG Voting System. Run folders in order on a freshly seeded development database. The collection configures the empty presentation election, casts votes, creates records, closes that election, and exercises a second draft election. Reset with `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`.

request.description: Authenticates the seeded administrator and stores the Bearer token in admin_token. Expected: 200. Errors: 401 invalid credentials, 422 invalid input, 429 throttled.
Finds the clean seeded draft election and stores its ID. Expected: 200.

exec: pm.test('Empty draft election is available', function () { pm.expect(election).to.be.an('object'); });

request.description: Creates the first presentation position and stores its ID. Expected: 201.

request.description: Creates the second presentation position and stores its ID. Expected: 201.
Adds the BSIT demo voter as a President candidate. Expected: 201.
Adds the HM demo voter as a President candidate. Expected: 201.
Adds the BEEd demo voter as a Vice President candidate. Expected: 201.
Adds the BSEd demo voter as a Vice President candidate. Expected: 201.
Activates the presentation election after its positions and candidates are configured. Expected: 200.

request.description: Creates a voter token used only for cross-role authorization tests. Expected: 200.

request.description: Valid administrator tokens must not access voter endpoints. Expected: 403.
Protected voter endpoint without authentication. Expected: 401.

item.name: Admin API without Accept Header - JSON Unauthorized

request.description: Protected API requests must return JSON 401 even when Accept is omitted.
Unknown Student ID must be rejected. Expected: 401.
Correct Student ID with wrong full name must be rejected. Expected: 401.
Graduated students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Stopped students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Validates Student ID, normalized full name, enrollment, active election, and prior participation. Stores voter_token. Expected: 200.
Returns the active election, positions, and candidates. Expected: 200. Errors: 401 missing token, 403 wrong token type, 409 no active election.
Revokes the current voter token. Expected: 200.
Obtains a fresh voter token after the logout test. Expected: 200.
Attempts to select Vice President candidate 20240102 for the President position. The backend must reject the mismatched candidacy. Expected: 422.

exec: pm.test('Wrong-position validation returned', function () { pm.expect(json.errors.selections[0]).to.include('invalid for President'); });

item.name: Too Many Candidates for One Position - Rejected

request.description: Submits two different President candidates even though the President position allows only one selection. Expected: 422.

exec: pm.test('Maximum-selection validation returned', function () { pm.expect(json.errors.selections[0]).to.eql('Too many candidates selected for President.'); });

request.description: Submits candidate 20240100 twice in one ballot. Application validation must reject the duplicate before any participation, ballot, or vote record is written. Expected: 422.

exec: pm.test('Duplicate-candidate validation returned', function () { pm.expect(json.errors.selections[0]).to.eql('The same candidate cannot be selected more than once.'); });

request.description: Creates participation, anonymous ballot, and candidate selections in one transaction. Revokes the token after success. Expected: 201.
Mandatory duplicate-vote test after successful submission. Expected: 409.

item.name: 01B - Concurrent Submission Security
item.description: Logs in a separate eligible voter and sends two vote submissions concurrently. The database-level participation constraint must allow exactly one request to succeed.

request.description: Obtains a dedicated token for the concurrency test. Expected: 200.

item.name: Two Simultaneous Vote Submissions - Only One Succeeds

request.description: The visible request confirms the token and ballot first. Its test script then starts two identical POST /voter/vote requests without waiting for either one to finish. Expected concurrent statuses: one 201 and one 409.

exec: pm.test('Ballot is available before concurrent submission', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Both concurrent requests completed without transport errors', function () { pm.expect(errors).to.be.empty; });
pm.test('Exactly one submission succeeds and one is rejected', function () { pm.expect(statuses.sort()).to.eql([201, 409]); });
const secondRequestOptions = Object.assign({}, requestOptions, { url: concurrentBaseUrl + '/voter/vote' });

item.name: 02 - Admin Read APIs
item.description: Read-only administrator checks. The folder starts with its own login so it can be run independently.

request.description: Refreshes admin_token so this folder can run independently. Expected: 200.
Returns turnout, candidate counts, team totals, and results by position. Expected: 200.

exec: pm.test('Course turnout is real and complete', function () {
const courseVotes = json.turnout.by_course.reduce(function (total, course) { return total + course.already_voted; }, 0);
pm.test('Live dashboard is not cached', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

request.description: Paginated student list with course and election-specific participation. Expected: 200.

exec: pm.test('Student participation fields exist', function () { const student = pm.response.json().data[0]; pm.expect(student).to.have.property('course'); pm.expect(student).to.have.property('has_voted'); pm.expect(student).to.have.property('voting_status'); });

request.description: Lists all elections, newest first. Expected: 200.

item.name: 03 - Admin Student Management
item.description: Administrator student creation and update checks. The folder logs in and generates a fresh Student ID each time it runs.

request.description: Refreshes admin_token so this folder can run independently. Expected: 200.
Creates an enrolled student. Expected: 201 on a fresh database; 422 if rerun without resetting.
Updates a student's name and academic eligibility. Expected: 200. Errors: 404 unknown student, 422 invalid status.

item.name: 04 - Draft Election Workflow
item.description: State-changing admin workflow. It starts with its own admin login, so this folder can be run independently. Run it after the voter tests because it closes the seeded election, then activates and closes the new draft election.

request.description: Authenticates the seeded administrator and refreshes admin_token so this folder can run by itself. Expected: 200.
Creates a draft election and stores draft_election_id. Expected: 201.
Updates draft configuration. Expected: 200. Non-draft elections return 409.
Creates the primary position for the draft election and stores draft_position_id. Expected: 201.
Updates a position while its election is draft. Expected: 200.
Creates a disposable position used to test deletion and stores temporary_position_id. Expected: 201.
Atomically saves the complete position order for a draft election. Expected: 200.

exec: pm.test('Positions are returned in saved order', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(String(data[0].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('temporary_position_id')); pm.expect(String(data[1].id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('draft_position_id')); });

request.description: Deletes an unused position from a draft election. Expected: 200.

request.description: Before sending, select a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP file no larger than 2 MB for profile_photo. Do not manually set Content-Type. Expected: 201.

Creates a second draft candidate used only to verify candidate deletion. Expected: 201.
Removes the election-specific candidacy while preserving the reusable candidate profile. Expected: 200.
STATE CHANGE: closes the seeded active election so the draft workflow can test successful activation. Run only after voter tests. Expected: 200.
